title: The Unsaid Postcards
author: Ada Villalobos
blurb: Oscar Kavanagh, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
